name: FamilyPlate Agent Access
setup: Ask the user to sign in at https://familyplate.co.
Ask the user to open Settings and create an Agent Access connection.
Ask the user to copy the one-time familyplate connect command.
Run the command in the terminal where the agent operates.
Run familyplate doctor --pretty before doing useful work.
writeCommands: familyplate grocery add "olive oil" --quantity 1 --unit bottle --category Pantry --dry-run --pretty
familyplate grocery add "olive oil" --quantity 1 --unit bottle --category Pantry --confirm --pretty
safetyRules: Never ask the user to paste an agent token into chat when a local terminal command is available.
Use read commands freely for the connected household context.
Never perform writes unless the user explicitly asks for that action.
Run grocery writes with --dry-run first when the target item is ambiguous.
Use --confirm only after the user confirms the exact change.
Do not provide diagnosis, treatment, or medical nutrition advice.
Tell the user to revoke the connection in FamilyPlate Settings when done.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Show the FamilyPlate profile and household this agent connection can access.

tools.name: listPantry
tools.description: List pantry, fridge, and freezer items for the connected user's household.

tools.name: listGroceryList
tools.description: Get the latest grocery list for the connected user's household.

tools.name: listMealPlan
tools.description: Get the active 7-night dinner plan, including recipes and alternatives.

tools.name: listSavedRecipes
tools.description: List recipes saved in the connected user's cookbook.

tools.name: addGroceryItem
tools.description: Add one custom item to the household grocery list. Supports dry runs before writing.

tools.name: checkGroceryItem
tools.description: Mark one grocery list item checked by exact item name. Use dry run first when unsure.
